task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue emergency edict declaring the epidemic a state of emergency, authorizing quarantine measures, mandating all regions prioritize containment and treatment over normal governance
Coordinate central response: allocate medical supplies and personnel to affected cities, organize treatment facilities, manage food and resource distribution for quarantined populations
Implement containment in their respective cities: establish quarantine zones, identify and isolate the sick, deploy local healers, report infection and mortality figures to central command
Disseminate the emergency edict and response orders to all regions, relay status reports and resource requests between zhuhou and central command, coordinate cross-region aid routing
